rawContent: @mervatim It’s a pretty great cluster that @QuigleyMM pulled together on #MeToo and Eliot, isn’t it? So happy it’s out in the world at last!

I have given them readings by Madeline Lane-McKinley on #MeToo, by Pumla Godobo-Madikizela on Language Rules in post-apartheid South Africa, and Mimi Kim on anticarceral feminism. But I need just a straight up essay on what civil war is, why & how it's different from other war.
